## About
Alameda Auto Body and Services is a collision repair shop on Everett Street in Alameda, serving customers across the East Bay. In our shop we handle collision-related body and frame repair, sheet metal and welding work, windshield chip repair and automotive painting.
We've built our reputation on quality, honesty, and value. We have experience working with insurance companies of all sizes, and our goal is to get you back on the road as quickly and safely as possible.
Our customers give us 4.7 stars from 296 Google reviews. One longtime customer wrote that we've taken care of her for decades.

## Services
- Collision repair: A full range of collision repairs and services, done in our own shop.
- Frame repair: We repair frame damage in our shop.
- Automotive painting: Paint work using computerized color-matching so the repair blends in with the rest of your car.
- Sheet metal and welding: Sheet metal and welding work done in our own shop.
- Windshield chip repair: We repair chips in your windshield.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We have experience working with insurance companies of all sizes to get customers back on the road as quickly and safely as possible.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: We accept Visa, MasterCard, and Discover.
